title: 第一章 咸鱼系统第二章 霖华仙尊
content_zh:
韩紫枫是来自古武世家韩家的庶女，在现在这个社会，她这些会点拳脚的，也只比普通人身体强壮一点，战斗技术，相对高一些。加上她的学习并不太好，顺利的成为学校中的有名的差生。
好在，她是一个比较懒惰的人，所以只要不惹到她，她还是比较平和的。她总感觉，学习这种东西，有点太难啦，其他的还能忍，但英文，那是上面鬼？又看没有懂就算啦，关键是为了满分，难为自己，何必呢？
数学，那又是上面鬼？算着，算着就哪里不太对。至于物理，化学，那就更是圈圈眼啦，完全是难为，她的感觉。面对考卷，她就想说：“果然，宝宝的天赋都点在武力值上啦。”
她的太极技术，那是场场比赛都能拿到奖杯。可看看试卷，叹气，毫无意外的，分数下来，全面飘红，她唯一的想法就是：“今天估计又是混合双打，不能反抗的那种，哎。”看看这个试卷，嗯嗯，很自信，自己一回家，肯定会被混合双打。
再次叹口气，就在她郁闷的时候，却听到一个相当诡异的机械声音：“叮，恭喜宿主激活咸鱼系统，系统绑定中。”
紫枫顿时问号，问号，问号，咸鱼系统是什么鬼？关键是，网络小说上，那些系统，一个比一个都牛b，可她混到一个咸鱼系统是什么鬼？
这个机械的声音，一漂而过，问题是，等到她到家，等到父母都把她抽完啦，那个咸鱼系统都没冒第二个泡。
她翻翻白眼，总感觉这个系统有点废，不，不，不是超级废，莫名的就有点嫌弃啊，这次知道第二天起床，这个咸鱼都没一点反映。
她无奈的问：“死鱼，活着不？你丫再咸也要给个详解吧？”
咸鱼系统懒懒的回答：“在~。咱是咸鱼，摆烂就好。”
她很无语的说：“详解。”
咸鱼系统沉默半天才丢出一个字：“没~。”
这次她都沉默啦，什么叫没，但凡能抓到这条鱼，她保证现把这个这个货红烧一边再说。她磨牙，真的磨牙啦，这个缺乏开发商的三无产品丢出来真的好嘛？
一整天上学回来，都晚上十点啦，她才发现，自己脑海中，冒出一个类似游戏模板一样的东西。左边上面是自己的照片，加上一个数据简介：
姓名：韩紫枫。性别：女。
体质：20（正常成年人10）。
力量：20（正常成年人10）。
速度：10（正常成年人10）。
韧性：20（正常成年人10）。
智力：5（普通人程度10）。

魅力：10（正常人10）。
悟性：10（正常人10）。
气运：20（正常人10）。
武功：太极拳、太极剑、梯云纵。
潜能：0。
积分：0。
右边下面还有包裹、抽奖、任务、好友，全部都是黑的，紫枫也被这个破系统给玩沉默啦，这是看不起她妈？是吧？再仔细瞄瞄，看到一个非常可爱的选项：投诉。
她也不想多费神，爽快来开投诉系统，标题就是：废物啊！
具体内容则是：没设计完，就别拿出来用啊！作为系统，三天说两个字，就算面板都是今天现做的吧？首先，新手大礼包，补发；其次，货币系统，既然是摆烂，没钱哪里来摆烂？你们这是打算饿死宿主，就能无耻换下一个，冲业绩吗？但凡有颗花生米，都不能设计出，这种连凡人游戏面板都比不上的东西吧？你们做系统的脸都不要了是吧？
咸鱼系统看着宿主反手就把自己投诉了，表示足够的无奈，而他家老大看到投诉，却很不厚道的笑出声，终于有填坑的志愿者啦。
紫枫很快就收到一条，叫她抓狂的信息：“叮，介于您是本尊接受到的第一单投诉，所有本尊决定，讲你升级为系统体验员。”
她被一句话给干蒙圈啦，总感觉自己被坑了第二次，于是她直接怼：“我家就不信，你是第一次被投诉，就这种半吊子的东西，你还没凡人写手脑洞好。要我给你打工，工资要发吧？福利要有吧？关键是，你这个摆明是坑我，无论是什么人，脑子里多这么个废物，正常都会投诉索赔一条龙吧？”
那个自称本尊的人沉默很久，老诚恳的回答：“一条龙是没问题，但你的那个世界灵气这么稀薄，根本养不起龙。”
紫枫沉默一下，咆哮：“我谢谢你昂，有空多读读书，你这个成绩，估计比我还差，投诉索赔一条龙，意思是，现投诉，再索赔，一口气全部办完。”
此时，宇宙深处的霖华仙尊，直接一个踉跄，他是误会啥了？被小员工鄙视了怎么破？他深吸一口气说：“咳咳，好吧，好吧，这个咸鱼系统，本尊设定出来后，也不知道该有的点啥。”
子沫淡定的说：“你是专业卖系统的，找我个凡人给你做下微调，更新？”
仙尊感觉，嗯嗯，终于聊到一起啦，他回答：“差不多，如果你这个凡人能用的差不多，能不投诉刷上几千字，那么基本上丢到下界，也是能有不错的用处。这活儿，你接不？”
紫枫开始琢磨起来，直接回答：“等我盘算下，话说，如果我表示，要我这个世界的灵气复苏，你有啥有建设性的意见不，至少我们这个国家，灵气复苏啊！”
仙尊很开心的说：“妹子，这个你真问对人啦，对你这样的科技文明代替修仙的世界，一个高级聚灵阵就能搞定，在家上一些含有灵气的食物，这些完全可以当成你的工资。”
紫枫直接怼：“少忽悠我，那些东西不值钱的好吧。”她沉默一下说：“这样，你玩过游戏不？拍卖行数据板，你的要的福利是一个绑定商城，卖的东西从热武器、到神器，各种功法，法术，从武侠转换成仙侠，你哪边是仙侠，光用拳头，内力的叫武侠。”
content_en:
Han Zifeng is a concubine from the Han family, an ancient martial arts family. In today's society, those who know how to punch and kick are only slightly stronger than ordinary people, and their fighting skills are relatively higher. In addition, her studies were not very good, and she successfully became a famous poor student in the school.
Fortunately, she is a relatively lazy person, so as long as she is not provoked, she is relatively peaceful. She always felt that it was a bit too difficult to learn this kind of thing. Others could be tolerated, but in English, was it the devil? It’s okay if you don’t understand it. The key is to get perfect marks. Why bother if it’s difficult for yourself?
Mathematics, is that the devil again? If you think about it, something is wrong. As for physics and chemistry, it was even more embarrassing and completely embarrassing, she felt. Facing the test paper, she just wanted to say: "Sure enough, the baby's talent is all about force value."
Her Tai Chi skills are such that she can win trophies in every competition. But looking at the test paper, she sighed. Not surprisingly, the scores came down and she was all red. Her only thought was: "It's probably mixed doubles again today, the kind that you can't resist, eh." Looking at this test paper, hmm, she is very confident. When she gets home, she will definitely be beaten by mixed doubles.
Sighing again, just when she was depressed, she heard a rather strange mechanical voice: "Ding, congratulations to the host for activating the salted fish system, the system is being bound."
Zifeng suddenly asked questions, question marks, question marks, what the hell is the salted fish system? The point is, in online novels, those systems are more awesome than the last, but what the hell is she doing with a salted fish system?
The mechanical sound passed by in a flash. The problem was that by the time she got home and her parents had finished smoking her, there was no second bubble in the salty fish system.
She rolled her eyes. She always felt that this system was a bit useless. No, no, it wasn't super useless. It just felt a little disgusting for some reason. This time, when she got up the next day, she didn't react at all.
She asked helplessly: "Is the dead fish alive? No matter how salty you are, you still have to give a detailed explanation, right?"
The salted fish system replied lazily: "Here~. We are salted fish, so we can just show it off."
She said speechlessly: "Details."
The Xianyu System was silent for a long time before saying one word: "No~."
This time she was silent. What did she mean? If she could catch this fish, she promised to braise it before talking about it. She is grinding her teeth, really grinding her teeth. Is it really good to throw out this three-no product that lacks developers?
After returning from school all day, it was already ten o'clock in the evening, and she realized that something like a game template appeared in her mind. On the left is a photo of myself, plus a data introduction:
Name: Han Zifeng. Gender: Female.
Constitution: 20 (normal adult 10).
Strength: 20 (normal adult 10).
Speed: 10 (normal adult 10).
Resilience: 20 (normal adult 10).
Intelligence: 5 (average level 10).
Charisma: 10 (normal 10).
Comprehension: 10 (normal person 10).
Luck: 20 (10 for normal people).
Martial Arts: Tai Chi, Tai Chi Sword, Ti Yun Zong.
Potential: 0.
Points: 0.
There are packages, draws, tasks, and friends on the lower right side, all of which are black. Zifeng has also been silenced by this broken system. Is this looking down on her mother? Right? Take a closer look and see a very cute option: Complain.
She didn't want to bother too much and just opened the complaint system. The title was: Waste!
The specific content is: Don’t use it until the design is complete! As a system, if you say two words in three days, even if the panels are all freshly made today, right? First of all, the novice gift package will be reissued; secondly, the currency system, since it is a mess, how can it be messed up without money? Are you planning to starve the host to death, so you can shamelessly replace it with another one to boost performance? No matter how small a peanut is, you can't design it. This kind of game panel is even worse than that of a mortal.Isn’t it something you can’t get on? You don’t even want to face the system anymore, right?
The Xianyu System saw the host backhand and complained to himself, expressing his helplessness. But when his boss saw the complaint, he laughed out loud unkindly. Finally, there were volunteers to fill in the hole.
Zifeng soon received a message that made her crazy: "Ding, since you are the first complaint I have received, I have decided to upgrade you to a system experiencer."
She was deceived by one sentence, and she always felt that she was being cheated for the second time, so she directly retorted: "My family doesn't believe it. This is the first time you have been complained. For such a half-baked thing, you are not as good as a mortal writer. If you want me to work for you, do you need to pay me a salary? Do you need benefits? The point is, you are clearly trying to trick me. No matter who you are, with such a piece of trash in your head, you will normally make complaints and claims through one-stop service, right?"
The man who claimed to be me was silent for a long time, and replied sincerely: "A dragon is okay, but the spiritual energy of your world is so thin that you can't raise a dragon at all."
Zifeng was silent for a moment and roared: "Thank you, Ang, for studying more when you have time. Your grades are probably worse than mine. Complaints and claims are one-stop service, which means you can complain now and claim again, all in one go."
At this time, Immortal Linhua in the depths of the universe stumbled. Did he misunderstand something? How to deal with being despised by a junior employee? He took a deep breath and said: "Ahem, okay, okay, after I set up this salted fish system, I don't know what to include."
Zimo said calmly: "You are a professional system seller. Can you find me, a mortal, to fine-tune and update it for you?"
The Immortal Lord felt, um, um, we finally got to chat, and he replied: "It's almost the same. If you, a mortal, can use it pretty much and can write a few thousand words without complaining, then basically throwing it into the lower world can be of good use. Can you take this job?"
Zifeng began to think about it and answered directly: "Let me think about it. By the way, if I say that I want the spiritual energy of my world to be revived, do you have any constructive opinions? At least in our country, the spiritual energy will be revived!"
The Immortal Lord said happily: "Sister, you really asked the right person about this. For a world like yours where technological civilization replaces the cultivation of immortals, a high-level spirit gathering array can handle it. You can serve some food containing spiritual energy at home, which can be regarded as your salary."
Zifeng directly retorted: "Don't fool me, those things are worthless." She said silently: "So, have you ever played the game? The auction house data board, the benefit you want is a binding mall, which sells everything from thermal weapons to artifacts, all kinds of exercises, spells, from martial arts to immortal warriors, you are an immortal warrior, you only use fists, and the internal strength is called martial arts."
